# Rushabh Ghule

> MBA candidate in Pune, India, with hands-on experience across inventory and sales, field operations, process research and organic content, including a Pinterest audience that peaked at 1.2M+ monthly views.

Rushabh Ghule is studying for an MBA (Operations specialization) at Neville Wadia Institute of Management Studies & Research, Pune (2025–2027), after a BBA from Savitribai Phule Pune University.

Key facts:
- Grew a photography-focused Pinterest account from April 2023 to 1.2M+ peak monthly views through consistent posting, Pinterest SEO and analytics. Audience (Oct 2026): 79% under 35, mostly mobile and international.
- Managed 14,000+ SKUs for an auto-parts business using BUSY 21 ERP (Inventory & Sales Executive, Jun 2024 – Aug 2025).
- Process Optimization Research Intern at Bright LumiTech (Feb – Apr 2026): mapped a 5-stage workflow and found the design phase took ~60% of total time.
- Operations Executive intern at IOWeb3 Technologies (Mar – May 2026): wrote SOPs and training guides for a rotating field team.
- Recommended on LinkedIn by Reuben D'Souza, Founding Member, who managed him directly at IoWeb3: "diligent", "dependable", trusted to build the team's SOPs.
- Campus Ambassador, GS Global Academy: 35% outreach response rate; 10+ campus events.
- Certifications: Google Analytics, HubSpot Inbound, HubSpot Digital Marketing, LinkedIn Marketing Strategy, IBM Data Fundamentals, greytHR HR Operations & Payroll.
- Projects in progress: BoardMaster (AI tool for Pinterest posting) and CandidatePro (AI job-application prep system).
